component.name: Encore
component.summary: Music from your Navidrome or Subsonic server

description.p: Encore plays your own music library from a Navidrome (or any Subsonic / OpenSubsonic) server, with podcasts, internet radio, lyrics, smart playlists and offline downloads. The desktop app works with Encore on your phone: the same account, the queue carries over, and each can control the other.
